featured.rule:
### Event Rules for Participants  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots.  
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All Other TruckersMP Rules Apply.  

### Event Rules for Event Staff  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All Other **[TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules)** Apply.

upcoming.name: November Konvoi der Fire Phoenix
upcoming.description:
Wir starten um 20 Uhr unseren November Monatskonvoi auf den Britischen Straßen von Birmingham aus in Richtung Glasgow. (~1.060Km), guckt bitte das ihr rechtzeitig bereit steht und vorm Konvoi Start bitte die LKWs Repariert und Auftankt damit der Start reibungslos ablaufen kann und keine Probleme mit den LKWs unterwegs entstehen können. Pickupstesten

Es wird bei diesem Konvoi KEINE Pause geben, also habe alles an Essen und Trinken parat wens los geht.

Wir Starten von Birmingham mit Singletrailer (Maximal 10T Fracht) in Fahrtrichtung Landschaft.

Zum Abschluss bleiben wir an der Spedition WGCC um Paar Gruppenbilder nach der Gemeinsamen fahrt zu machen, dafür Parken/stellen wir die Auflieger ein/zur Seite damit die nicht stören oder im Weg stehen
upcoming.rule:
Es gilten die Standart Konvoi regeln:
- Überholen ist Strickt untersagt. Wenn Fremdfahrer auf der Karte oder im Tab auftauchen sollten, Passieren lassen
- Konvoispitze gibt die Geschwindigkeit an, versucht bitte mindestens 100 Meter zu eurem Vorderman einzuhalten um rechzeitig reagieren zu können (ausweichen/Bremsen)

We are delighted to invite you to the first official convoy of Kocaeller Logistics!

Join us as we celebrate the launch of our virtual trucking company with an international journey from Rotterdam, Netherlands, to Hamburg, Germany.

**Event Information**

- Date: 21 November 2026
- Server: Simulation 1
- Meetup: 17:30 UTC (20:30 TRT)
- Departure: 18:00 UTC (21:00 TRT)
- Starting City: Rotterdam, Netherlands
- Destination: Hamburg, Germany

**Convoy Rules**

2. Maintain a safe distance between vehicles.
3. Reckless driving and intentional collisions are strictly prohibited.

*The Best Solution for Your Logistics Needs!*
upcoming.rule:
## Kocaeller Logistics | Official Convoy Rules

1. All participants must follow the official TruckersMP rules at all times.
2. Reckless driving, intentional collisions, blocking, and trolling are strictly prohibited.
3. Maintain a safe distance from the vehicle in front of you.
4. Follow all instructions given by authorized convoy staff, provided they comply with TruckersMP rules.
5. Overtaking other convoy participants is prohibited unless necessary for safety or permitted by TruckersMP rules.
6. Respect all drivers and maintain professional behavior throughout the event.
7. Follow the designated convoy route whenever possible.
8. Do not use excessive horns, flashing lights, or other disruptive behavior.
9. Participants must use roadworthy trucks and comply with all applicable TruckersMP vehicle regulations.
10. Enjoy the journey and represent the trucking community with professionalism and respect.

**Kocaeller Logistics Management Team**

*Drive Together. Grow Together. Deliver Excellence.*

We invite all **Wortex Group Company (WGC)** drivers to join us on the road for our regular weekly company convoy! Come together with the team, represent our fleet with pride, and enjoy a well-coordinated group drive across Europe.

**Event Information**

* **Game Platform:** Euro Truck Simulator 2 (TruckersMP)
* **Server:** Simulation 2
* **Required DLC:** None (Base Game Required Only)

**Event Schedule**

* **Date:** November 21, 2026
* **Meeting Time:** 17:45 UTC / 20:45 TSİ
* **Departure Time:** 18:45 UTC / 21:45 TSİ


**Route & Participation Details**

* **Route Map:** [View Original Route](https://i.imgur.com/8ZiE8rq.png)
* **Eligibility:** This event is exclusively organized for **WGC drivers**. Please ensure you are wearing the official company livery and tag prior to departure.
* **Convoy Flow:** As we are operating on **Simulation 2**, standard TruckersMP traffic rules apply at all times. Please stay alert around busy junctions, maintain a safe following distance of **70m – 100m**, and follow instructions from the Convoy Leader and Event Staff.

**Feedback & Support**

* **Feedback:** Share your thoughts or post-convoy suggestions in [Feedback Channel](https://discord.com/channels/1432044774495355023/1432044775837794388).
* **Support Ticket:** For any questions or assistance regarding the convoy, open a ticket via [Events Department](https://discord.com/channels/1432044774495355023/1432044775980404868).

*Prepare your trucks, fuel up ahead of time, and see you at the lineup!*

upcoming.description:
We are excited to invite you to the TAMILNADU TRUCKING CREW NOVEMBER CONVOY #07! Join us for an exciting journey this October as we take the roads from MAGDEBURG and create another memorable convoy experience together.

Get ready for an engaging drive filled with great routes, fellow truckers, and the spirit of the TAMILNADU TRUCKING CREW community. We look forward to having you with us and making this convoy another successful journey!

upcoming.rule:
Event Rules for Participants:

Participants must haul a trailer.
Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
Overtaking is prohibited.
Cars are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.
Event Rules for Event Staff:

Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

upcoming.rule:
Event Rules for Participants:

- The Event Staff are recognized as "UC | CC, UC | CCS, UC | ST, UC | Lead, UC | Tail, UC | MT, UC | ROS, UC | RO,  UC | GM" or similar.
- Impersonating Event Staff using the above-mentioned tags is forbidden.
- Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Overtaking is prohibited.
- Participants must haul a trailer.
- Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
- Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
- Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
- Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park at the 'Public Parking' slot
- Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
- Cars and Buses are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.

Event Rules for Event Staff:

- Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
- Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
- Event Staff are permitted to park out of bounds as long as it is on the ground and not on top of a building or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.
